items.shortLine: Meet Grace & walk through your plan
items.detailText: Get acquainted with Grace on your first day, walk through your onboarding plan together, and get clear on what's expected in the first weeks.
A walk around the Austin office with Caleb, one of your new teammates — where things are, how the space works, all from someone who isn't your manager.
A self-paced session covering Veridian's vision, values, departments, and where we work — Tel Aviv HQ, London, and Austin. The first of six sessions on the company (1 of 6).
A short self-paced course covering the security basics everyone at Veridian needs to know.
A quick read on how we work together and what's expected of everyone at Veridian.
Email, calendar, and shared drive for day-to-day company communication — set up before you even start.
Slack access lands on Day 1 — where the North America Success team and cross-functional partners communicate day to day.
Notion access is ready Day 1 — home for Veridian's Customer Success playbooks and the CS-NA team's own docs.
HiBob is ready Day 1 — your employee profile, time off requests, and the org chart.
Salesforce access lands Day 4 — your primary CRM for managing accounts, opportunities, and customer records across your North America book.
Gong access arrives this week — for recording and reviewing customer calls, handy for coaching your CSMs on call quality.
Zendesk access arrives this week — visibility into support tickets raised by your accounts.
Your manager will assign you a Human Buddy soon — they'll be your go-to person for the everyday questions and how things really work around here.
Get the full operating picture of the team from Grace in one sitting — mission, metrics, workflows, key interfaces, and where to find docs and reports.

items.shortLine: Meet the whole NA Success team
items.detailText: Meet the North America Success team in one sitting rather than waiting weeks for individual intros.
Get set up on benefits and logistics, with a direct contact at HR from here on.
A self-paced look at what Veridian builds: Knowledge Hub, AI Assistant, AI Agents, and Governance. Session 2 of 6 on the company.
A course on how the team uses Salesforce day to day — good grounding before you're relying on it for your own portfolio.
A short course on data privacy fundamentals, required for everyone at Veridian.
A self-paced session on Veridian's market and the kinds of customers it serves. Session 3 of 6 on the company.
A self-paced session on Veridian's business model. Session 4 of 6 on the company.
A self-paced session on the key metrics Veridian tracks. Session 5 of 6 on the company.
Connect with Sales — the team you'll partner with closely on renewals and expansion deals.
Connect with Product — where you'll feed in customer feedback that shapes what gets built next.
Stay aligned with Grace this week and flag anything that already feels off track.
A self-paced session on Veridian's strategic direction and near-term roadmap — the last of the six company sessions, now that you've got the fuller picture behind you.
A self-guided look at what the role actually covers — owning a large North America portfolio, coaching your CSM pod, and reporting on NRR and churn.

items.shortLine: Say hello to James, your skip-level
items.detailText: Meet James Wilson, Director of Enterprise Success — the person who leads the broader group your team sits in.
A quick sync with Grace this week to catch anything before it piles up.
A session with Grace on where Customer Success & Support fits into Veridian and what it's aiming for this year.
A self-guided read through the policies that matter most day to day — hybrid work, security, expenses, and customer data.
This week's check-in doubles as your 30-day review — stepping back with Grace to see how the first month matched the plan and re-prioritize together.
Build a direct relationship with Rachel Cooper in People, beyond the initial HR intake session.
A deeper certification on Veridian's product suite — useful for speaking credibly with customers about what they're using.
Keep the weekly rhythm going with Grace and raise anything that needs attention.
A short sync with Grace to stay in step and catch anything early.
A focused course on the fundamentals of managing at Veridian — team rhythms, coaching, and what's expected of you as a people manager.
Your weekly touchpoint with Grace — stay aligned and clear out any blockers.

internalGaps: human_buddy_email is not set for this hire. Office tour used a fallback guide (Caleb Harris, teammate at the same Austin office) rather than the buddy.
company_overview only has basic summary fields (name, category, employee count, offices) - no product description, ICP, or business-model detail exists anywhere in the source data.
DEMO ASSUMPTION (see prompts/process-expert.md and README.md): business-track LMS sessions 3-6 have no real source data behind them - descriptions are topical only.

This employee has 0 direct reports currently listed in the DB despite being Manager-track (a newly-created CS-NA pod lead role) - Manager-track structure still applies, but no direct_report 1:1s were scheduled since there's no one to schedule them with yet. Re-run once reports are assigned.
JD Extractor found no conflicts between the job posting and the Roles catalog (ROLE-015, Customer Success Manager, Manager track, M2-M3) - noted for completeness, nothing needs resolving.

The stated portfolio size ($10M+ ARR) comes from the job posting's candidate-requirements language, not a confirmed statement of this role's actual assigned scope - role content deliberately hedges this instead of repeating it as settled fact.
The department overview (week 4) defaults to the direct manager as facilitator since no dedicated 'Trainer' role exists in this dataset.
This plan does not include applied 'doing' work tickets (out of scope by design for this pipeline).
